description: Quality-resource trade-off of weight quantization on SK instances (Tables 2-3, Fig. 2, Sec. 5.2-5.3).
family: SK: complete graph, w_ij ~ N(0,1), minimize E_w = sum w_ij z_i z_j
objective: angles maximize the expected ORIGINAL cost; the phase Hamiltonian of each arm is divided by its standard deviation over all bit strings
optimizer: L-BFGS-B; p = 1: best of 10 random starts; p >= 2: INTERP start + 5 random starts; random-start seed = seed * 100 + arm_index * 10 + p (arm_index = position in 'arms')
cost: VALUE construction, batch B = 16, T_rot = 40 (delta = 1e-4), Toffoli = 4 T
